answer: What survives to the hollow is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The spiral lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the copper is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, forfeited on duplicate submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
